title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct order of magnitude for the Doppler width, approximately 1.44 x 10^-2 Å.

title: Energy Equation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the equipartition of energy principle to relate temperature and velocity.

title: Velocity Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must compute the average velocity using the correct mass and temperature values.

title: Doppler Width Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should use the correct formula for calculating the Doppler width based on the velocity and wavelength.

title: Unit Consistency

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the calculations.
